# define and run generic marker rotation + outward diagonal ray from every four diagonal markers around 2x2 block
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for r in range(h-1):
      for c in range(w-1):
        if grid[r][c]==grid[r][c+1]==grid[r+1][c]==grid[r+1][c+1]==2: continue
        # locate four markers diagonally one cell beyond each corner
        pts=[(r-1,c-1),(r-1,c+2),(r+2,c-1),(r+2,c+2)]
        if not all(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and grid[a][b] not in (0,2) for a,b in pts): continue
        vals=[grid[a][b] for a,b in pts]
        new=[vals[2],vals[0],vals[3],vals[1]]
        for (a,b),v in zip(pts,new): out[a][b]=v
        for (a,b),v,(dr,dc) in zip(pts,new,[(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]):
          a+=dr;b+=dc
          while 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and out[a][b]==0: out[a][b]=v;a+=dr;b+=dc
    return out
'''
